summary: Connect perception, planning and control while defining what happens when any component fails.
outcomes: Set timing and failure-response contracts across the loop
Design staged simulation, replay and supervised hardware validation
sequence: Identify hazards and independent stop mechanisms
Inject stale data, dropped messages and actuator faults
Progress from simulation to replay and hardware-in-the-loop
Record residual risks and acceptance evidence

visual.question: What action follows when the latest sensor state is too old?
visual.interaction: Delay components and trigger a defined simulated safe response

practice.task: Write and execute a simulation-only integration acceptance plan
practice.success: Fault cases have measurable detection and response criteria; physical tests require a separate supervised risk assessment
